text: じつは……　レッドに　おねがいが　あるんじゃ　しっかり　きいてくれ

structure.jp: レッドに　おねがいが　あるんじゃ
structure.en: I have a favour to ask of you, Red

structure.jp: しっかり　きいてくれ

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end adds the feel of explaining; んじゃ is its old-man, shortened form. おねがいが あるんじゃ = 'I have a favour to ask, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form verb is a plain, manly way to ask someone to do something for you. きいてくれ = 'listen to me'.
